purpose: Complete the minimal reciprocal action, remove unobservable parameter duplications, and exhaust a declared ten-family weak-field search space before any astronomical parameter fit.

canonical_action.equation: S = integral sqrt(-g) [M_Pl^2 R/2 - M_Pl^2((grad X)^2 + L_X^-2 X^2)/2 - M_Pl^2 c_U F_U^2/4 + lambda(U^2+1)] + S_m[g_tilde, matter]
canonical_action.physical_metric: g_tilde_mn = exp(2 alpha X) [g_mn + 2 beta X U_m U_n]
canonical_action.dust_limit: J_X = (beta-alpha) rho c^2, so (nabla^2-L_X^-2)X = (alpha-beta) 8 pi G rho/c^2
canonical_action.cosmological_contrast_rule: T-T_background is not inserted as a one-way local source. First solve the homogeneous cosmological background; the perturbation delta X is then sourced by delta J_X on the U-defined slicing.
canonical_action.vector_caveat: The Maxwell-aether truncation is a weak-field control only. Its complete scalar/vector mode health and preferred-frame PPN limits are not assumed to pass.

weak_field_observables.point_source_field: X = -2 d G M exp(-r/L_X)/(c^2 r)
weak_field_observables.removed_parameter: kappa_X is not independent in the canonical reciprocal action

search_boundary.source: universal baryonic stress-energy contrast plus cosmological boundary data; no per-object charge
search_boundary.metric: one universal physical metric; no lensing-only normalization
search_boundary.MOND_boundary: A local scale-invariant p-Laplacian that recreates the MOND/AQUAL galaxy equation is recorded but not pursued, following the user's direction to leave that branch.
search_boundary.meaning_of_exhaustive: Exhaustive over the ten declared combinations of linear/nonlinear/local/nonlocal response and conformal/disformal/self-stress metric completion. This is not a claim to enumerate every mathematically possible field theory.
